newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 16.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* U.S. stocks capped a record-breaking week with a broad-based rally Friday, and bonds and the dollar rose after a new report showed inflation well under control. The Dow Jones industrial average jumped 70.57 points to 7,782.04, its sixth consecutive record.
* Indonesia's central bank reported that Indonesia's offshore debts were US$109.3 billion as of last March, while foreign exchange reserves increased to $19.9 billion.

* On Friday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed 3.4 points, or 0.49 percent, higher at 698.62 points on late buying across the board, boosted by improved sentiment in property and banking issues, brokers said.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,428.00/29.00 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,427.50/28.50.

* Property firm PT Surya Semesta Internusa on continued market talk that the firm would link up with a firm controlled by a local conglomerate. The company is scheduled to hold an annual shareholders meeting on Monday afternoon.
* Property developer PT Kawasan Industri Jababeka on an announcement that it posted a net profit of 67 billion rupiah in the 1997 first quarter against 23 billion rupiah in the same 1996 period.

* Blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) after Finance Minister Mari'e Muhammad reportedly confirmed last week that government is studying the possibility of merging the seven state banks into four entities.
* Bank Papan Sejahtera following reports that the Indonesian central bank will divest its 13.11 percent stake in the bank.
